newsitem.title: USA: Accustaff to meet or best Q4, 1997 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Accustaff to meet or best Q4, 1997 estimates.

text.p: Accustaff Inc will either meet or exceed analysts' earnings estimates in its fourth quarter and during fiscal 1997, the company's chairman, Derek Dewan, said.
Dewan said Accustaff will meet the estimates because of strong revenue and margin growth in all segments. He also said the company will make "at least" two acquisitions before the end of the year.
The company is expected to earn $0.18 a share for the fourth quarter and $0.85 a share for fiscal 1997, according to the average estimate of two analysts surveyed by First Call.
